 Notice of Material Change

Treasurer of the Knights of Columbus 9544 Council, Holy Redeemer, Kanata, Ontario.
 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as Member of the Veterans Review and Appeal Board , I recused myself on June 12, 2024, from participating in any discussion or decision regarding the revision of a case in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of a friend of mine.
The name of the friend should not be disclosed pursuant to sec. 51 (2) (b) (vi) of the Conflict of Interest which reads as follows:
51 (2) If a public office holder has recused himself or herself in respect of a matter and a public declaration is made in respect of that recusal under subsection 25 (1) or section 30
(b) no publication of the declaration shall include any detail that could reveal, directly or indirectly, any of the following:
(vi) information that could reasonably be expected to cause injury to the privacy interests of an individual.
